title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1970-02-04
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a compact, high‑energy half‑hour set that many reviewers call one of the best moments in Dead history.
ai_review.review: The recording is a Cotsman soundboard source and listeners report clear, well‑balanced audio with no noted flaws. Reviewers rave about the performance, calling this brief set possibly the best thirty minutes of the Dead ever, despite its short length. The setlist flows tightly through classic numbers and seamless segues.

ai_rating.rationale: All substantive reviews are strongly positive (5‑star, 4‑star) and praise both the music and the lack of audio issues; the soundboard source suggests high technical quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No complaints about clarity or mix; reviewers note typical Cotsman soundboard fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A concise, high‑energy half hour that moves through a varied setlist with tight transitions (e.g., China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider).
